notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, causing you to create a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Beast token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
